_comment: Registry of map sources for the House Social Cesium globe. Every URL is a template; {z}/{x}/{y} are Web-Mercator tile indices. To move to a self-hosted server later, change only the 'url' fields (or ship a remote copy of this file via --dart-define=GLOBE_SOURCES_URL=...). 'proxy': true means the mobile in-app proxy may fetch and disk-cache it. 'commercial': yes | dev-only | verify.
